Name: Azariah, Son of Jeroham
Summary: Azariah, son of Jeroham, was one of the captains of hundreds Jehoiada took into covenant to crown Joash.
KeyStory: Jehoiada took Azariah the son of Jeroham into covenant with him in the seventh year.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Jeroham, Father of Azariah
LifeLesson: Courageous captains backed a priest's plan to restore the rightful king.
